title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Evening Brief – 1 November 2026
headline: Government Announces Fast-Track Courts and Cultural Initiatives

top_developments.headline: Tamil Nadu Orders 26 POCSO and Four NDPS Fast-Track Courts
top_developments.summary: Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has ordered the immediate setup of 26 special courts under the POCSO Act and four courts under the NDPS Act. The new judiciary units aim to expedite long-pending trials and ensure swift justice for victims across the State. A formal government press release confirmed the decision following a high-level administrative review meeting.
top_developments.why_it_matters: Speeds up severe criminal trials involving child abuse and narcotics, addressing major case backlogs in the state judiciary.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu to set up 26 POCSO Act courts and four NDPS courts

top_developments.headline: Tamil Nadu Celebrates Formation Day as Leaders Trade Greetings
top_developments.summary: The Tamil Nadu government celebrated Tamil Nadu Day on Sunday with state-wide events and cultural programs. President Droupadi Murmu, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay extended public greetings acknowledging the State's linguistic and historical identity. Simultaneously, the opposition DMK asserted that July 18 remains the legally accurate date for the celebration, sparking a minor debate over formation history.
top_developments.why_it_matters: Highlights ongoing political disagreement regarding official state calendar milestones and historical regional identity.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Day: Vijay government celebrates November 1; DMK says July 18 is the right date

sections.government_and_administration: - **TN Announces Weekly Traditional Attire Day and Secretariat Tamil Sangam:** School Education Minister Rajmohan announced that government employees and ministers must wear traditional attire on a designated weekly day to support the handloom sector. Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay approved the proposal, alongside plans to establish a Secretariat Tamil Sangam. ([DT Next](https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/tn-to-introduce-weekly-traditional-attire-day-in-government-offices-cm-vijay-to-head-secretariat-tamil-sangam))
sections.political_parties_and_opposition: - **AIADMK Chief EPS Slams TVK Government Over Rising Prices:** AIADMK General Secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticized the ruling TVK administration, alleging that the government has delivered nothing to citizens in six months except skyrocketing commodity prices and poor governance. Palaniswami likened the current state administration to a vehicle operating without brakes. ([The New Indian Express](https://news.google.?oc=5))
sections.assembly_courts_and_policy: - **Madras HC Bars Public Meetings Targeting Sitting Judges:** The Madras High Court ruled that public meetings and protests targeting sitting judges cross legal boundaries, declaring that malicious caste-based attacks against the judiciary do not fall under the protection of free speech. ([Organiser](https://news.google.?oc=5))
sections.district_developments: - **Heavy Security in Pudukottai Ahead of Chief Minister Vijay's Visit:** Pudukottai district has been placed under strict security cover by multiple police divisions ahead of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay's official visit on Monday to inaugurate a new bus stand and an indoor stadium. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/pudukottai-brought-under-heavy-security-cover-for-cms-visit-on-monday/article71652676.ece))
